target: claim takes arbitrary from/to, so 'claim queued specd' reaches specd without spec_check or the irreversibility classifier — the gates advance enforces
cmd: bash "$FIXTURES/tracker-gates/mkspec.sh" specs 900 queued; if FACTORY_SPECS_DIR=$PWD/specs bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" claim queued specd who >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo BYPASSED; else echo REFUSED; fi
